title: payment.screening.requested v1
description: Published by payment-event-service on topic payment.screening.requested when a payment is created with screening enabled. The payment stays HELD until a payment.screening.completed verdict or an officer decision. Message key: paymentId.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Always 1 for this schema; a breaking change gets a new file and number.

eventId.description: Unique id of this event (UUID). A redelivery of the same event has the same eventId.

amount.description: Positive decimal as a string, so no precision is lost in transit (e.g. "125.50").

createdAt.description: When the payment was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
